The MemoChat C++ backend is built using vcpkg-managed dependencies.
All vcpkg packages are compiled from source using the pinned versions
recorded in vcpkg.json / vcpkg-lock.json at the root of the repository.

Primary vcpkg dependencies and their licenses:

  openssl          3.6.0   Apache-2.0
  libpq (PostgreSQL) 16.9  PostgreSQL License (MIT-style)
  mongo-c-driver   1.30.6  Apache-2.0
  boost            1.87    Boost Software License 1.0
  msquic           2.x     MIT
  nghttp2          1.68.0  MIT
  zlib             1.x     zlib/libpng License
  brotli           1.x     MIT
  c-ares           1.x     MIT
  libxml2          2.x     MIT
  openldap         (headers only)  OpenLDAP Public License
  re2              (abseil/re2)    BSD-3-Clause
  abseil-cpp       20240116  Apache-2.0
  grpc             (via abseil)    Apache-2.0
  protobuf         (via grpc)      BSD-3-Clause
  lz4              1.9     BSD-2-Clause / GPLv2 dual (BSD chosen)
  zstd             1.5     BSD-3-Clause / GPLv2 dual (BSD chosen)
  libevent         2.x     BSD-3-Clause

Per-package license texts are embedded in the SBOM (vcpkg-build-
dependencies.spdx.json) generated during the release build and included
in each service bundle's sbom/ directory.

vcpkg project home: https://github.com/microsoft/vcpkg
SPDX SBOM format:  https://spdx.dev/
